title: Without The Name, Everything Is Painful
summary: The shabad does not leave ego at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: O Nanak, without the Name, everything is painful, and happiness is forgotten
lifeApplication: Notice where the self wants the line to confirm it instead of soften it. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: The self-willed manmukhs die in egotism-even their death is painfully ugly; o Nanak, without the Name, everything is painful, and happiness is forgotten
source.lifeApplication: Notice where the self wants the line to confirm it instead of soften it. Let this line guide the first honest return after the reaction.
